> Definitely feels like the wrong UI. I find myself struggling to find past posts I've written or stuff from others. I feel a bit like a drunk waltzing through a charming carnival, not sure what is a two bit puppet show and what's a palace of knowledge.

I think I just need one feature to be fine: you can click on a transclude and go to that item in the same view and only open a new tab if it’s not a blyg link. If you preserve a history of clicks and also have a ◀️⏮️⏪⏩⏭️ type buttons you’ll stay oriented. This is exactly the kind of navigation I worked on in trailmeme 18 years ago. This is the worm’s eye view. You can construct a birds eye view but it’s less useful than you might think. Here you’d get a wishbone type structure from the main linear feed. If we can build flywheels around more pinning behavior that’s a useful third dimension.

But also… the disorientation is sorta the point? You don’t want to overly legalize the naturally illegible. You want to surrender to the disorientation. Sense-making is a creative act. Collect things in hoppers and then write new posts out of hoppers. I don’t want to overcorrect. The optimal amount of drunken waltzing and lostness is not zero.
